svg.title: Your work continues across changing projects and AI teams
svg.desc: Separate chats require the person to retell decisions, chase source versions and reconcile claims. Retained project records let the next authorized reader inspect the handoff, check the local view and follow evidence. A capable agent handles permitted technical steps; missing scope, new access and consequential decisions still require human authority.

g.text: Keep your work in the loop.
WHEN CONTEXT STAYS IN SEPARATE CHATS
“Tell the new AI what we decided.”
Find each project’s decisions and open work.
Check the snapshot against local inputs.
The next authorized reader has a starting point.
Let the agent handle permitted setup steps.
Bring people the decisions that need them:
